shadows.name: flat-light-lift
shadows.purpose: Only shadow in the system: flat cards in light themes.

shadows.name: glass-edge
shadows.value: 1dp border, vertical gradient from card border to 25% of it
shadows.purpose: Lit top edge on Tidepool cards.

components.name: Card
components.description: Tidepool glass card, the app's one container.
components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.08), rgba(255,255,255,0.048)); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22); border-radius: 28px; padding: 20px; color: #EAF2F7; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Floating bar; selected item widens into an accent-container pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 68px; padding: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22); border-radius: 28px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-on { flex: 2.6; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #3A3470; color: #E4E0FF; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-nav-off { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #9FB3C2; }

components.name: Keypad Key
components.description: Digit key; dips and takes the accent container while pressed.
components.css: .ds-key { width: 88px; height: 56px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #EAF2F7; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.13); border-radius: 20px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, background .2s; } .ds-key:active { transform: scale(0.93); background: #3A3470; } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B7CFF; }

components.name: Transaction Row
components.description: Bare list row: glyph disc, title and subtitle, tabular amount.
components.css: .ds-tx { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 4px; box-sizing: border-box; color: #EAF2F7; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-tx-glyph { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(34,197,94,0.2); } .ds-tx-text { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-tx-text b { font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; } .ds-tx-text small { font-size: 12px; color: #9FB3C2; } .ds-tx-amt { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; color: #F43F5E; }

narrative.overview: The look is the user's. One set of roles read through Furi.colors, three axes the user turns independently: pack, accent, background. Roles are derived, not picked, so any combination stays readable. Material 3 supplies structure; brand lives in theme roles. Motion is a feature, scaled by one slider and dropped under Remove animations.
keyCharacteristics: Five packs: Tidepool, Afterhours, Ledger (light only), Void (dark only), Gumdrop.
Sixteen accent swatches plus Dynamic, Custom and Photo-picked; default Iris.
Six backgrounds: mesh, aurora, particles, gradient, solid, photo.
Tabular figures for every money amount.
Semantic income, expense, warning with a colorblind-safe set.

rules.name: The Derived Accent Rule
rules.body: No screen uses a raw swatch. Accent roles come from AccentDerivation.derive against the worst surface; accent text holds 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Worst Surface Rule
rules.body: Contrast is measured against the page composited with the most hostile blob. Body text 7:1, muted 4.6:1.

rules.name: The Photo Flip Rule
rules.body: Over a photo, text tone follows photo luminance after dim, not the system theme.

rules.name: The One Edge Rule
rules.body: Pack neutrals carry their own border; accent edges appear only in the outline card style.

rules.name: The Roll Rule
rules.body: Changing money rolls digit by digit; non-digits stay still.

rules.name: The Pack Owns Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from the pack's card style; screens add no shadows or borders.

dos: Do read colour from Furi.colors and shape from MaterialTheme.shapes; never hard-code a hex in a screen.
Do wrap grouped content in FuriCard and leave list rows bare on the page.
Do run every animation through Furi.motion so the slider and Remove animations apply.
Do show money with Furi.figures and AnimatedAmount.
Do keep 48dp minimum touch targets and a 20dp screen gutter.
Do derive any new accent-based colour with AccentDerivation against the worst surface.
donts: Don't ship a single house style with a dark/light toggle; a new surface must look right in all five packs.
Don't offer Ledger in dark or Afterhours and Void in light.
Don't use raw swatch colours for text or thin strokes.
Don't put shadows, borders or fills on a screen that the pack's card style should supply.
Don't animate outside Furi.motion or ignore the intensity setting.
